_week: 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-15 (Week 46). Written from this week's numbers.
week_story: Sales rose 5.5% to $4,819 on 293 units (+15.8%) and 241 orders (+13.7%). Mexican Cerveza more than doubled to $1,142 (91 units); the Variety 12 Pack fell 23% to $1,715. Kolsch (+24%), Hazy IPA (+15%) and Cherry Blossom (+15%) grew; West Coast IPA fell 15%.
refunds: Refunds were $118.02 (5 units) vs $166.01 (6 units) last week: $72.10 (3 units) on West Coast IPA and $45.92 (2 units) on the Variety 12 Pack.
pacing_reco: At $661 a day, November projects to $19,838, below October's $24,197. Closing the gap needs cheaper category ads and stock in place for BF/CM.
ads_context: ACoS rose to 89.1% from 71.2%; TACoS was steady at 26.3% (26.0% last week).
Spend rose 6.8% to $1,267 while ad sales fell 14.6% to $1,422, so each ad dollar returned $1.12 vs $1.40.
ads_strategy: Branded keywords returned $368.38 on $82.85 (22.5% ACoS) for 15 orders.
Category keywords cost $954.50 for $963.53 (99.1% ACoS); remarketing spent $139.10 for $10.99.
bid_moves: Lower bids on the Variety Pack category exact campaign: $266.09 for $202.93, 7 orders.
Pause no-sale spend: Hazy IPA remarketing ($59.77), Cherry Blossom broad ($34.91), Kolsch competitor targets ($30.51).
coupons: Coupons ran on about 1 in 5 orders this week.
promotions: This week: 65 promotion orders and $262.80 in promotional discounts (vs $357.21 last week).
events: Black Friday / Cyber Monday: Nov 27 – Nov 30.
Deal and coupon set-up deadlines: to confirm with the account team.
Stock below is the Nov 2 sheet: the Nov 13 sheet update has mismatched ASINs and SKUs.
reviews_body: Sellerise has a review signal for one product only: Hazy IPA, rated 4.3, with no new or negative reviews in the last 90 days.
The other five products return no review records, so ratings per product can't be shown yet.
reviews_reco: Turn on review tracking for every RationAle ASIN in Sellerise (or pull Amazon's Customer Reviews report).
Check recent reviews on West Coast IPA, where 3 of this week's 5 refunded units came from.
recommendations: Lower bids on the Variety Pack category exact campaign ($266.09 spend, $202.93 sales, 131% ACoS) and “non alcoholic beer” exact ($206.88 for $170.43).
Cut the 31 campaigns with spend and no sales ($315.41), starting with remarketing: $139.10 for $10.99.
Move budget to branded keywords: 22.5% ACoS, 15 orders; “rationale” exact made $190.62 on $17.02.
Add “non alcoholic ipa beer” as an exact keyword: 2 orders, $37.21 from $3.55.
Clear the dimensions alerts on Mexican Cerveza (Nov 11, Nov 14) and Cherry Blossom (Nov 14).
Republish the inventory sheet: the Nov 13 update pairs ASINs with the wrong SKUs and has no as-of date.
Decide on the 19.2oz Tallboy: 0 available, 0 inbound, 52 sold in 30 days (Nov 2 sheet).
Lock BF/CM coupons and deals (Nov 27–30) and confirm submission deadlines.
position: November is at $9,919 through Nov 15, vs $2,274 for the same days last year.
Orders grew, but ads cost more: ACoS 89.1%, ad sales down 14.6%.
next_steps: Cut no-sale and high-ACoS ad spend.
Fix the inventory sheet; decide on Tallboy.
